description: This Java source file implements a PaymentModule for handling PayPal Express Checkout transactions within an e-commerce system. It manages the setup, authorization, capture, and refund processes for PayPal payments by interfacing with PayPal's API via SOAP requests, and contains logic for configuration validation, transaction initialization, and payment processing flows.

classes.name: PayPalExpressCheckoutPayment
classes.description: Implements PayPal Express Checkout payment processing, including transaction initialization, authorization, capture, refund, and configuration validation.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the necessary credentials and keys in the integration configuration for the PayPal module, specifically the API username, signature, and API key.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating that direct transaction initialization is not implemented.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Begins the PayPal authorization process using a payment token and item details, setting up the transaction for user approval.

methods.name: initPaypalTransaction
methods.description: Creates and prepares a PayPal checkout session, assembling payment details, setting return and cancel URLs, and calling PayPal's SetExpressCheckout API to obtain a token for user redirection.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Handles combined authorization and capture procedure for PayPal, similar to 'authorize' but executing both steps.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund (full or partial) through PayPal API, recording the refund transaction details.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Executes the steps to retrieve checkout details from PayPal and complete the payment, resulting in a transaction record.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized PayPal transaction by calling the DoCapture API, recording the capture details.
